problem_restatement: Determine whether the frozen HYPE-only native long replacement or its predeclared mature-profit floor improved the live portfolio strongly enough to justify a proposed change, using three prospective lifecycles and exact retained public execution evidence.

correction_chain.reason: One-minute 0x price rows did not contain the exact public mark stop crossing; the later local websocket mark archive falsified the technical rejection.
The local mark established the stop trigger, but the report retained the later BBO-proxy exit instead of repricing at the first causal retained public L2 book.
The mark trigger, first causal public L2 depth, fees, residual slippage, and exact funding are reconciled under the frozen execution contract.

uncertainties_and_failure_modes: The depth result is an exact retained public-book counterfactual, not a private venue fill receipt.
Three trades are too sparse to estimate durable expectancy or regime stability.
The positive floor total depends on the largest winner; removing it makes the result negative.
A different future market regime can update the economic conclusion, but it cannot retroactively change this frozen window.

validation.static_checks: Ruff clean; changed Python files at most 500 lines; changed functions at most 50 lines
validation.falsifier: Reopen only if independently retained source-native HYPE evidence with the same frozen identity and cost model produces positive net after removing the largest winner in a predeclared forward window.

recommendation.1_recommendation: Reject both the v54 HYPE-native replacement and the mature-profit-floor live change; leave v53 untouched.
recommendation.2_why_now: The predeclared third lifecycle is resolved and the decision boundary is no longer right-censored.
recommendation.3_evidence_reviewed: Three prospective lifecycles, local receipt-causal mark and L2 archives, exact funding, preregistered decision rule, and frozen floor comparison.
recommendation.4_observed_problem_or_opportunity: The replacement is negative and winner-concentrated; the floor helps headline net but remains negative without the largest winner.
recommendation.5_applicable_regime: Only the observed v54 HYPE breakout-onset long window; no general regime claim is made.
recommendation.6_alternatives: Keep v53, deploy native v54, deploy the floor, or start a new HYPE-only reconstruction of the original breakout lineage. The first and fourth are retained; the two live changes are rejected.
recommendation.8_expected_upside: Avoid deploying a negative, concentrated challenger while preserving an exact reusable stop-resolution pipeline.
recommendation.9_downside_risks: Keeping v53 may remain low-frequency or unprofitable; a new investigation may also fail and costs more evidence time.
recommendation.10_completed_validation: Exact third-trade resolution, immutable decision, immutable floor comparison, focused tests, provenance rechecks, and live-process non-mutation.
recommendation.11_still_required: A new predeclared HYPE-only original-breakout reconstruction must prove source, entry, exit, and friction parity before any proposal.
recommendation.12_success_metrics: Positive cost-inclusive forward net, positive net excluding largest winner, no technical gaps, and no cross-asset parameter transfer.
recommendation.13_rollback_or_rejection_trigger: Reject the next candidate if technical provenance fails, the edge disappears without its largest winner, or actual live-source exit semantics differ from replay.
recommendation.14_confidence: High confidence in rejecting this exact three-trade candidate; low confidence that three trades identify HYPE's durable best strategy.

next_investigation.scope: Reconstruct the original HYPE-only breakout lineage before the cross-asset transfer and later parameter changes, then evaluate it with the now-correct mark-trigger and causal-depth exit semantics.
constraints: no post-result tuning of the forward window
no live strategy, risk, or configuration change without a separate evidence-backed proposal and explicit approval
